content: No, that is not correct. In Switzerland, as in many other countries with postal voting systems, the voting certificate must be properly signed and enclosed with the ballot paper in the return envelope. The signature on the voting certificate serves as a verification that the voter has personally cast their vote and is accountable for the ballot. Without a valid signature, the vote may be considered invalid. Always check the specific postal voting regulations provided by your local authority or electoral office for accurate and up-to-date information.
